phase: CarePoint Phase 3 - End-to-End QA, UAT & Production Readiness
purpose: Prepare production readiness, deployment, rollback, observability, UAT consumption, and go-live/pilot decision evidence.

readinessDomains.name: Environment and configuration
gates: Environment variables are documented in .env.example without real secrets.
Deployment target identifies environment name, URL, release package, and owner.
API, Admin, Provider, and Python worker configuration are reviewed before promotion.
Runtime feature flags and dry-run/advisory boundaries are documented.

readinessDomains.name: Build and release package
gates: npm install completes on the deployment workstation or CI environment.
npm run build:api completes without errors.
npm run build:web completes or is formally deferred for a backend-only pilot.
npm run audit:qa completes with QA-V1 through QA-V6 coverage.
Release ZIP and SHA-256 are archived as immutable evidence.

readinessDomains.name: Database, migration, seed, and backup
gates: Database connection target is confirmed for the intended environment.
Migration command is known and tested in staging or equivalent environment.
Backup/restore procedure is documented before go-live.
Seed or demo data strategy is documented for pilot/UAT continuity.

readinessDomains.name: Security and privacy smoke
gates: No real secrets are committed to the repository.
Protected routes and APIs reject unauthenticated access.
Role boundaries from QA-V1 and QA-V2 are validated before signoff.
Logs and error evidence avoid sensitive data exposure.

readinessDomains.name: Observability, monitoring, and support readiness
gates: Operational logs are available to the support owner.
Known error classes and escalation paths are documented.
Post-go-live monitoring window and owner are assigned.
Support runbook references final V64, UX-V6, and QA evidence.

readinessDomains.name: Rollback and continuity
gates: Rollback trigger criteria are defined for P0/P1 failures.
Prior stable baseline and release artifacts are retained.
Database rollback or recovery strategy is documented.
Communication owner is assigned for go/no-go and rollback decisions.

readinessDomains.name: UAT signoff consumption
gates: Admin acceptance package is available from QA-V5.
Provider acceptance package is available from QA-V5.
Platform/Technical Owner signoff package is available from QA-V5.
No unresolved P0 defect remains open before production readiness signoff.
P1/P2 deferrals have owner, mitigation, and target follow-up.

readinessDomains.name: Go-live or pilot decision
gates: Go/no-go meeting has named decision owner and attendees.
Go-live checklist completion percentage is recorded.
Open risks are listed with owner and mitigation.
Pilot/staging/production target is explicitly selected.
Post-go-live hypercare window is assigned.

productionReadinessCommands.purpose: Install dependencies before build and audit execution.
Validate API and shared contract build.
Validate Admin and Provider web builds.
Run QA-V1 through QA-V6 evidence scanners.
Validate Option B Python worker readiness.
Validate workspace structure and expected package layout.

defectGate.p0: Blocks production readiness until resolved or release owner approves documented mitigation.
defectGate.p1: Must be triaged with owner, mitigation, target release, and explicit release-owner decision.
defectGate.p2: May move to post-go-live backlog if not blocking pilot or production use.
defectGate.unknown: Cannot be ignored; classify before go/no-go review.

riskRegisterTemplate.risk: Environment-specific build failure after package extraction.
riskRegisterTemplate.mitigation: Run npm install, npm run build:api, npm run build:web, and archive logs before promotion.

riskRegisterTemplate.risk: Migration or seed mismatch between staging and production.
riskRegisterTemplate.mitigation: Confirm migration plan, backup, restore path, and dry-run result.

riskRegisterTemplate.risk: Incomplete role signoff or unresolved P0/P1 defects.
riskRegisterTemplate.mitigation: Use QA-V5 role acceptance gates before go/no-go.

riskRegisterTemplate.risk: No assigned owner for post-go-live monitoring or support.
riskRegisterTemplate.mitigation: Assign hypercare owner, monitoring window, escalation path, and rollback owner.

riskRegisterTemplate.risk: Sensitive data appears in logs or committed configuration.
riskRegisterTemplate.mitigation: Run secret checks and review logs/errors before signoff.

exitGates: QA-V1 through QA-V5 evidence is present and complete.
Build/API/Web/Python worker validation commands are executed in the target environment and archived.
No unresolved P0 defect remains open.
P1/P2 deferrals have explicit owner, mitigation, and follow-up target.
Environment, migration, backup, rollback, and monitoring owners are named.
Go/no-go decision is recorded before pilot, staging signoff, or production go-live.
